data.name: ElevatedActivate
data.value:
CashGear Capture is already running as administrator. Windows only lets programs that also run as administrator talk to it, so this copy can't hand over to it.
Use the tray icon of the copy that is running, or exit it (tray icon › Exit) and start CashGear Capture again.

data.name: ElevatedExit
data.value:
CashGear Capture is running as administrator. Windows only lets programs that also run as administrator talk to it, so --exit can't close it from here.
Exit it from its tray icon (› Exit), or run the command again as administrator.

data.name: ElevatedCommand
data.value:
CashGear Capture is running as administrator. Windows only lets programs that also run as administrator talk to it, so --{0} can't reach it from here.
Use the running copy's tray icon or hotkeys, or exit it (tray icon › Exit) and start CashGear Capture again.
data.comment: {0} is a command-line switch such as capture-region
